eval_dataset_example.problem:
Consider a dielectric block with polarization `\(P\) and internal energy \(U\) which obeys`

`\[ U(T, P) = CT + f(P)\,,\]`where 𝑓(𝑃) is the polarization-dependent part of the internal energy.

where `\(CT\)` is the internal energy of the unpolarized dielectric block, `\(C\)` is the heat capacity of the dielectric block, and `\(T\)` is the absolute temperature. For convenience, any possible volume
